note: A PM FAIL names Plan, and the re-spawned PM appends a new, complete plan with the next Attempt: (2, so revision r2) that restates every task rather than a delta, and classifies it again. cites.text: If a FAIL or a `rerun: Plan` blocker names Plan, append a new, complete `## PM — Plan` entry with the next `Attempt:` and classify it again from scratch.
Every revision is the complete plan: restate every task and never refer to an earlier revision for any part of it.
A re-run after a FAIL or a `rerun:` blocker is a new attempt under the plain heading, never `(cont.)`, and complete on its own.
